name: Box2D / Qt project
description: A standalone CMake project: a Qt window that fetches Box2D, builds this scene and runs it.

settings.label: Project name
settings.tooltip: The CMake project, the executable and the window title. Letters, digits and underscores.

settings.label: Add controls
settings.tooltip: A toolbar with Start, Pause and Stop. Without it the window opens running and there is nothing to press.

settings.label: Qt prefix path
settings.tooltip: Where Qt is installed, e.g. C:/Qt/6.5.1/mingw_64. Written into the project as CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH so it configures without being told on the command line. Leave empty to let CMake find Qt itself.

settings.label: Steps per second
settings.tooltip: How often the exported project steps the world. The editor's own setting is not carried across, since it is a preference rather than part of the scene.

settings.label: Debug view
settings.tooltip: Adds a Debug view switch to the controls: body axes and where the rays are looking, drawn over the scene.

settings.label: Box2D repository
settings.tooltip: The git repository the generated project fetches Box2D from. Point it at a fork, a mirror or a local clone. Whatever is there has to speak the Box2D v3 API, which is what the generated code is written against.

settings.label: Box2D tag or branch
settings.tooltip: Which commit of that repository to build. Pinned to a tag by default, so the project builds the same way twice.

settings.label: C++ standard
settings.tooltip: What the generated project is compiled as. The generated code itself is C++17; raise it for whatever you add to the project afterwards.
